text: Episode fifteen. Selling a ticket, start to finish. Setting the price, taking the money, and confirming it came in.

A tier is a price and a way to pay. Card online, through Stripe. Bank transfer, with your instructions on the ticket. Cash at the door. Or free. And a fixed price, or pay what you can, with a floor and a ceiling.
Twelve euros, by bank transfer. The instructions you type here go on the buyer's ticket. Twenty seats, and save. There it is, next to the other two.
The buyer picks it, and gets a pending ticket with your instructions on it. It counts toward capacity, but it's not valid at the door yet.
When the transfer lands, one click confirms it. The ticket goes active, the buyer is told, and the numbers at the top follow.
Every payment method, one ticket list. Revel is free and open source. Find it at lets revel dot io.
